name: 97306 · Salem, OR
findings: ZIP 97306 (Salem) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97306 (Salem) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
